usedFor: Sellers use Ebay with “List recent orders” to see what sold, and “Get products” to check their listings, often in a daily digest.

bestTemplate.name: “List recent orders” in Ebay
bestTemplate.why: It returns the latest orders, so an AI agent can sum up the day’s sales or flag orders that need shipping.

watchOut: Ebay has no trigger here, so a schedule has to start the check; new orders show up on the next run, not the moment they arrive.
